description: StudioTerminal.stop()/close() end the whole process tree of a session and close() says when it could not: lib/studio-terminal.mjs (processTreeLeft, the Windows reaper, the output cap, close()'s report), judged by tests/verify-studio-terminal-close.mjs (a fake process table on every platform, real orphaned node.exe on Windows).

mutations.name: TC-tree-no-age
mutations.what: a process older than the shell that has the same parent pid is taken as the shell's child

mutations.name: TC-tree-no-until
mutations.what: the children of a new process that got the shell's pid are taken as the shell's

mutations.name: TC-tree-root-always-ours
mutations.what: a process that got the shell's pid later is taken for the shell

mutations.name: TC-tree-root-never
mutations.what: a shell that is still alive is not part of what is left

mutations.name: TC-tree-one-level
mutations.what: only the direct children of the shell are found, not their children

mutations.name: TC-tree-null-is-empty
mutations.what: an unreadable process table is read as 'nothing left'

mutations.name: TC-reap-no-sweep
mutations.what: after taskkill nothing that is left of the tree is killed (the code before the fix)

mutations.name: TC-reap-no-deadline
mutations.what: the reaper never gives up

mutations.name: TC-reap-no-fallback
mutations.what: when taskkill cannot be started the child is not killed directly

mutations.name: TC-reap-sweeps-brokered
mutations.what: the process table of this account is swept for a brokered command too

mutations.name: TC-stop-no-reaper
mutations.what: stop() on Windows does not start the reaper

mutations.name: TC-cap-status-first
mutations.what: the output cap sets 'stopping' before stop(), which then kills nothing (the code before the fix)

mutations.name: TC-cap-records
mutations.what: output past the cap stops the session but is still recorded

mutations.name: TC-close-always-closed
mutations.what: close() reports closed whatever happened

mutations.name: TC-close-no-pending
mutations.what: close() does not name the sessions it could not end

mutations.name: TC-close-no-log
mutations.what: the session log does not say which processes were still running

mutations.name: TC-close-log-no-table
mutations.what: the log does not tell an unreadable process table from a process that is still running

patches.old: const message=x.left===null?'Terminal not closed: the process table could not be read to find what is left of the stopped command.':

mutations.name: TC-close-returns-nothing
mutations.what: close() returns nothing (the code before the fix)

mutations.name: TC-list-null
mutations.what: the real process table is never read (Windows)

mutations.name: TC-list-no-ppid
mutations.what: the real process table loses the parent pid (Windows)

mutations.name: TC-list-no-time
mutations.what: the real process table loses the creation time (Windows)
